claims: Adesanya vs. Pyfer takes place on Saturday, March 28, 2026.
Adesanya vs. Pyfer takes place at Climate Pledge Arena in Seattle.
Adesanya vs. Pyfer features a middleweight main event between former champion Israel Adesanya and Joe Pyfer.
Adesanya vs. Pyfer main card begins at 8 p.m. ET.
Adesanya vs. Pyfer preliminary card starts at 5 p.m. ET.
Adesanya vs. Pyfer streams on Paramount+.
UFC Seattle main card includes Women’s Flyweight: Alexa Grasso vs. Maycee Barber (Co-main).
Lance Gibson Jr. vs. Chase Hooper.
UFC Seattle preliminary card includes Women’s Flyweight: Casey O’Neill vs. Gabriella Fernandes.
Event details are based on reports for March 28, 2026.
